name: Anthony Carter
bio:
Anthony's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for taking things apart and putting them back together, often with 'improvements'. Growing up in Detroit, surrounded by automotive culture, naturally led him to pursue mechanical engineering. He quickly excelled in machining, drawn to the precision and problem-solving it demanded.

At Academy Motorsport, Anthony is known for his methodical approach and unwavering attention to detail. He thrives in the high-pressure environment, meticulously crafting and maintaining crucial components. His ability to quickly adapt to new designs and challenging requests makes him a valuable asset to the team. He's always eager to learn new techniques and push the boundaries of what's possible with machining.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Anthony is of average height, with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting a task.
Has a collection of vintage machinist tools on display in his workspace.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day, no matter how busy he is.
